blocks.text: Reach at least 2,400 Power with all three circles at 75 or higher in five completed Strength attempts in a row. Rest is allowed.
Reward: Strength-game EXP +20%, Silver +15%, and circle accuracy used for Power +5 (capped at 100). Perfect awards still require unassisted 100 accuracy.
Original game award. Existing unlock requirements are preserved.
